name: G10 FX Fair Value: EUR/USD vs USD/JPY Rate-Differential OLS Model
description: Cross-sectional research study comparing EUR/USD and USD/JPY dislocation from rate fundamentals using rolling 252-day OLS fair value models. Each pair is regressed against its pair-specific 10Y rate differential: EUR/USD uses Euro Area 10Y minus US 10Y (wider spread → stronger EUR), USD/JPY uses US 10Y minus Japan 10Y (wider spread → weaker JPY). Outputs include a dislocation snapshot (z-score bar chart + summary table), per-asset fair value overlays, z-score history, cross-sectional z-score comparison, and rolling beta evolution.
source:
# =============================================================================
# G10 FX FAIR VALUE: EUR/USD vs USD/JPY RATE-DIFFERENTIAL OLS MODEL
# =============================================================================
# Rolling 252-day OLS regression of FX spot against pair-specific 10Y rate
# differentials. Compares which G10 pair is more dislocated from fundamentals.
#
# Rate differentials:
#   EUR/USD: Euro Area 10Y (IRLTLT01EZM156N) minus US 10Y (DGS10)
#   USD/JPY: US 10Y (DGS10) minus Japan 10Y (IRLTLT01JPM156N)
#
# Model: FX_spot = alpha + beta * rate_diff  (rolling 252-day window)
# =============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c

# Load interest rate series
us_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
us_10y = ffill(us_10y_raw.result)

jp_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
jp_10y = ffill(jp_10y_raw.result)

ez_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01EZM156N', use_alfred=False)()
ez_10y = ffill(ez_10y_raw.result)

# ============================================================================
# PAIR-SPECIFIC RATE DIFFERENTIALS
# ============================================================================

# Detect which asset is being processed
is_eurusd = is_asset_ref(ticker='EURUSD')()
is_usdjpy = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDJPY')()

# EUR/USD differential: Euro Area 10Y - US 10Y (wider → stronger EUR → higher EUR/USD)
eurusd_diff = ez_10y - us_10y

# USD/JPY differential: US 10Y - Japan 10Y (wider → weaker JPY → higher USD/JPY)
usdjpy_diff = us_10y - jp_10y

# Route correct differential per asset
rate_diff = conditional_select(is_eurusd, eurusd_diff, is_usdjpy, usdjpy_diff, 0)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING OLS FAIR VALUE MODEL (252-day window)
# ============================================================================

ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)
alpha = ols.intercept
beta = ols.slope
residual = ols.residual

# Fair value = alpha + beta * rate_diff
fair_value = alpha + beta * rate_diff

# Residual z-score (rolling 252-day normalization)
resid_mean = sma(period=252)(residual)
resid_std = stddev(period=252)(residual)
resid_zscore = where(is_valid(resid_std) and resid_std > 0, (residual - resid_mean) / resid_std)

# Deviation from fair value in pips
# EUR/USD: 1 pip = 0.0001, so multiply by 10000
# USD/JPY: 1 pip = 0.01, so multiply by 100
eurusd_pips = (close_fx - fair_value) * 10000
usdjpy_pips = (close_fx - fair_value) * 100
deviation_pips = conditional_select(is_eurusd, eurusd_pips, is_usdjpy, usdjpy_pips, 0)

# Safe z-score for display (0 when insufficient history)
z_display = resid_zscore if is_valid(resid_zscore) else 0.0

# Bar timestamps for time-series reporters
ts = index().value

# ============================================================================
# 1. DISLOCATION SNAPSHOT
# ============================================================================

# Cross-sectional bar chart: current z-score per pair
cs_bars(
    title='Which G10 Pair Is More Dislocated Right Now?',
    category='1. Dislocation Snapshot',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (+ Rich / - Cheap)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    order=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Fair Value', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ Rich', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ Cheap', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(z_display)

# Cross-sectional summary table: key metrics per pair
cs_summary_table(
    title='Fair Value Model Summary',
    category='1. Dislocation Snapshot',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=1,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Fair Value Model Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Spot Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fair Value', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Dev (pips)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Beta', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title='Alpha', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(close_fx, fair_value, deviation_pips, z_display, beta, alpha)

# ============================================================================
# 2. FAIR VALUE OVERLAY (per-asset)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Spot vs OLS Fair Value',
    category='2. Fair Value Overlay',
    y_axis_label='Price',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Spot', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fair Value', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(close_fx, fair_value))

# ============================================================================
# 3. Z-SCORE HISTORY (per-asset)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rate-Model Deviation Z-Score',
    category='3. Z-Score History',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, title='+2σ Rich', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.0, title='+1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Fair Value', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.0, title='-1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, title='-2σ Cheap', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=z_display)

# ============================================================================
# 4. CROSS-SECTIONAL Z-SCORE COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

cs_lines(
    title='EUR/USD vs USD/JPY: Deviation Z-Score Over Time',
    category='4. Z-Score Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=z_display)

# ============================================================================
# 5. ROLLING BETA (per-asset)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling OLS Beta (Rate Sensitivity)',
    category='5. Model Parameters',
    y_axis_label='Beta',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rolling Beta', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=beta)
